## Master's minor 30 ECTS

## Digital Media and Communication for Social Impact

<!-- image -->

## ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS

The same admission requirements apply as for the Master's in Digital Media and Communication for Social Impact.

## COURSES

Information on the courses offered by the Faculty of Management, Economics and Social Sciences as part of the modules is published at the beginning of the academic year in the detailed study plan and on the Internet.

## FURTHER INFO

If you are completing this minor as part of a Master's degree in the Faculty of Philosophy, you must earn 30 ECTS in this programme before defending your Master's thesis.
